✦
A little planning. A lot less waste.

Automatic layouts pack toward the top-left. Manual adjustments can change offcut positions; saw kerf remains between cuts. Each board is filled with individual pieces that fit before opening another board. Part order does not matter, and copies of a part can be split across sheets. With rotation off, automatic layouts use straight guillotine cuts. With rotation on, the optimizer also searches unrestricted rectangular nesting for better panel use. All layouts account for saw kerf. Manual placement allows other arrangements; plan the cutting sequence for those layouts. The optimizer compares multiple part orders and stock sizes, prioritizes placing all requested parts, then selects the fewest panels. When panel counts are equal, it selects the least stock area to reduce waste, then fills Board 1 as fully as possible, followed by Board 2 and subsequent boards. For equally filled boards, it favors large, contiguous offcuts along the right and bottom edges. It finds the best layout searched; a global optimum is not guaranteed.

Built for the way you make. SHEETWISE / CUT SMARTER
